hotspots.title: Howard Lutnick Nvidia Export Probe & Firing Crisis
hotspots.blurb: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick are locked in escalating administration infighting over unbanned Nvidia AI chip exports to China-linked firm Megaspeed. Lutnick faces mounting pressure and Senate subpoena demands as administration officials publicly trade blame, accompanied by sensational reports alleging Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had ties to a Chinese operative.
hotspots.affect: High-level administration backstabbing combined with national security vulnerabilities drives intense outrage and political intrigue across conservative and mainstream commentary.

hotspots.title: Turning Point USA Campus Cane Attack Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Coverage continues to center on the arrest and assault charges following a cane attack against a Turning Point USA representative at UT Tyler, alongside newly surfacing reports of altercations at other university chapters. Conservative media outlets are heavily highlighting the incident as evidence of systemic left-wing violence against young activists on college campuses.
hotspots.affect: The controversy functions as a high-charge focal point for conservative victimhood narratives and campus culture-war outrage.

hotspots.title: Brazilian Prosecutor Seeks Rejection of Bolsonaro Annulment
hotspots.blurb: Brazil's Prosecutor General (PGR) formally submitted a recommendation to the Supreme Court rejecting Jair Bolsonaro's petition to annul his criminal conviction and electoral bar regarding the January 8 coup attempt. Concurrently, Flávio Bolsonaro is broadcasting defiance from the United States, attacking court restrictions and parliamentary fiscal votes.
hotspots.affect: The ongoing judicial clampdown on Bolsonaro keeps legal jeopardy and claims of political persecution at peak emotional resonance among supporters.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox launched its official election campaign for the upcoming November 29 general election with aggressive platform pledges focused on reindustrialization and border control. Party leader Santiago Abascal sparked widespread media backlash after pulling out of a high-profile podcast interview and launching attacks against public broadcaster RTVE.
hotspots.affect: Electoral stakes combined with high-visibility media squabbles generate intense ideological investment and partisan friction.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) announced former 1990 World Cup football champion and prominent COVID-19 'Querdenker' skeptic Thomas Berthold as its nominee for the German Federal Presidency. The nomination has drawn significant media coverage and establishment pushback due to Berthold's anti-lockdown activism.
hotspots.affect: The choice of a pandemic-skeptic sports icon serves as a deliberate cultural provocation designed to channel anti-establishment resentment.
